screen.openorigins.config.title: OpenOrigin config
toast.openorigins.outdated: Your OpenOrigins is too old! Please update to use server features.
feature.openorigins.location_tracker.des: Shows your current location in Discord status.
feature.openorigins.enhanced_cosmetics.d: Answers the server handshake and enables server-driven cosmetics. Applies after reconnect.
feature.openorigins.smooth_animations.de: Interpolates armor stand poses for silky animations.
feature.openorigins.block_enhancements.d: Fixes custom-block flicker and blocks useless right-clicks.
feature.openorigins.ghost_block_fix.desc: Slows client-side digging of custom blocks to avoid rollback ghosts.
feature.openorigins.expand_model_boundin: Keeps large models rendered at screen edges and from afar.
feature.openorigins.hide_names.desc: Hides name tags when the HUD is hidden (F1).
feature.openorigins.auction_ping.desc: Plays a sound and shows a toast when your auction lot sells.
feature.openorigins.scoreboard_desync_fi: Tolerates stale scoreboard team packets instead of disconnecting.
feature.openorigins.badger_task_hud.desc: Shows the active badger task requirements on the HUD.
